mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real final sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If joint increases in HOUST and RSAFS do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between joint increases and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of decreasing UNRATE and increasing PAYEMS does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between this joint condition and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% signals increased borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% during tightening do not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during tightening cycles.
